title: EOPF Sentinel-2 L2A (GeoZarr, Zarr V3), one pinned item
description:
EOPF (ESA/EODC) Sentinel-2 L2A GeoZarr-samples collection "sentinel-2-l2a-zarr3". The EOPF STAC collection rotates its items constantly (new items arrive continuously), so this fixture pins one current item, S2A_MSIL2A_20261105T133251_N0513_R024_T27WWR_20261105T175156 (datetime 2026-11-05T13:32:51Z, UTM zone EPSG:32627, bbox from the item itself), fetched from `/collections/sentinel-2-l2a-zarr3/items?limit=1` on build. The `reflectance` asset is a GeoZarr multiscales group `r10m`..`r720m` (EPSG:32627 via proj:code, confirmed per-level in the group's own spatial:* attributes), sharded (inner chunk 1024x1024 within an 11264x11264 shard at r10m), uint16 scale 1e-4, offset -0.1 (BOA reflectance, _FillValue 0). b02/b03/b04 statistics below are in raw DN (not reflectance units) so a single-variable ramp has something to rescale against.

License: ESA/Copernicus Sentinel Data Legal Notice (not a standard SPDX license); declared "proprietary" with a via link.

Expected browser outcome: draws (true colour, r10m).
